corrections.text: The headline states a '45% Faster PDF Viewer Startup', the summary says 'roughly 45%', and the body says startup speeds 'increased by approximately 45%'. The Firefox release notes actually say the built-in PDF viewer 'starts up to 45% faster', so 45% is an upper bound, not a typical or approximate improvement.

The article says Windows ARM64 processors 'now support hardware H264 decoding for WebRTC video calls'. The Firefox release notes say such devices 'may now use hardware H264 decoding instead of falling back to software', which is conditional rather than a blanket support statement.
